text:
maria_pm: Heads up — Acme (renewal in ~6w) just escalated. They want a 99.95% SLA + tail latency guarantees for their critical routes. They implied committed spend could double if we agree. Need a quick prioritization call.

derrick_sales: they pushed this in the renewal call this morning, sounded pretty firm. They care most about consistent p95/p99 for chat endpoints.

june_eng: 99.95% is a big operational commitment. We need to scope what that actually means (per-route vs global, regional failover). Can we get their traffic profile?

olivia_csm: sending sample QPS and route split now — see link: https://redwood.internal/acme/qps (shared).

mike_sre: immediate concern: we currently have SLOs at 99.9% across hosted customers. Hitting 99.95% for a single customer increases oncall noise and capacity needs. Also need SLA automation (billing credits, measurement).

june_eng: quick options I see: 1) Offer Dedicated cluster + strict routing (isolates risk) 2) Add product-level SLA features (more telemetry, per-route SLOs, SLA dashboards) 3) Commercial workaround: smaller SLA + credits. Each has different eng effort.

maria_pm: can we do a rapid RICE-style compare? Even rough numbers are fine — we need a prioritization recommendation by EOD to feed sales/legal.

june_eng: ok quick back-of-envelope: \n``` \nRICE calc (rough):\n- Reach: 200 (estimated $/yr logos that could want this)\n- Impact: 7 (high commercial impact for renewals)\n- Confidence: 0.5 (uncertain, prototype work needed)\n- Effort: 40 engineer-weeks (inc infra, metrics, billing integration)\nScore = (200*7*0.5)/40 = 17.5\n```\n
derrick_sales: compare that to dedicated offer (lower effort): Reach 50, Impact 6, Confidence 0.8, Effort 6w -> score = (50*6*0.8)/6 = 40

nora_product_ops: important to include sequencing cost: quick Dedicated + playbook buys time to build product SLA correctly.

mike_sre: operational burden for Dedicated is higher per-customer but confines risk. Product SLA work is high upfront and increases platform complexity if we do per-route SLAs.

sam_cto: strategic note — building product SLA features makes us more competitive for enterprise, but it's a large bet. If sales pipeline shows multiple customers asking, that shifts the math.

olivia_csm: Acme said they'd be willing to pilot Dedicated for 3 months if we can put a migration path to product SLA in the contract.

maria_pm: proposed recommendation: 1) Offer Dedicated + temporary SLA for renewal (commercial concession) 2) Kick a focused 6-week engineering spike to define product SLA scope and metrics 3) If spike returns, plan a prioritized roadmap item next quarter.

june_eng: timeline note: spike = 6w (design + minimal telemetry + test harness). Full product SLA roughly 3-4 quarters.

derrick_sales: need pricing language for Dedicated + pilot SLA. Legal will want crisp measurement windows and credit formula.

mike_sre: we'll need automated measurement and a billing hook for credits. Deploy_bot: can create an SLO export job but needs eng ticket.

maria_pm: action items: \n- @derrick_sales draft renewal commercial (Dedicated + pilot SLA) by 2pm\n- @june_eng scope engineering spike by EOD (deliverables + risks)\n- @mike_sre list ops requirements for Dedicated pilot\n- @nora_product_ops prepare decision doc with RICE numbers and sequencing recommendation

Can we do a 30m sync at 3:30pm? If not, I'll surface the recommended path to execs at 4pm.

olivia_csm: I'm on for 3:30. Acme will accept pilot terms quickly if we have something tangible. :+1:

sam_cto: thumbs up to the recommended path. Prefer quick pilot over committing to product-level SLA before we validate demand.

maria_pm: cool — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a one-pager and the RICE table after the sync.

deploy_bot: Note: created ticket INFR-4821 to add SLO export job placeholder (untriaged).
